_why: Tools that existed on 2026-08-26 with no battery prompt. They are GRANDFATHERED, not approved: nothing has ever asked them to do their job, so nothing is known about them and none can be judged, let alone deleted. Shrinking this list is the work; adding to it is the rot. A NEW tool may not join it — see toolPromptCoverage.test.ts.
_what: THE NAMED FLOOR (AI-1q done-condition): every entry is a tool deliberately not exercised by unattended prompts, with its reason. The list may only SHRINK (a tool gaining a prompt leaves), and every entry MUST have a reason — enforced by toolPromptCoverage.test.ts.
